'''Sealing''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Sealoon]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Sealing becomes depressed when the ball is lost, possibly because the bald spot can no longer be hidden."

Sealing is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A blue seal or sea lion with a white underbelly and an orange beach ball balancing on its head. Its eyes seem to be perpetually shut.

Sealing's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces blue with purple, and its ball becomes red-orange and aquamarine.

== Evolution Trial ==
Sealing's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Sealoon]] you need to complete the following task:
* Shoot 2,400 pinballs. Get inspired!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "None of the young Sealings are forced to fight Zobos, and the balls on their heads are just toys."
